title: OpenClaw与Ollama在代理式AI中的应用：迈向完全自主且可扩展的AI代理系统
summary: 本文提出代理式AI的分层架构，区分推理、编排和执行层。通过OpenClaw与Ollama的全栈集成验证，证明持久记忆、工具使用和自适应决策等能力源于系统级集成，并探讨了可扩展性、安全、隐私及评估挑战，为构建自主代理系统提供路线图。
summary_en: This paper proposes a layered architecture for Agentic AI, separating inference, orchestration, and execution. Validating with OpenClaw and Ollama, it shows capabilities emerge from system integration, and discusses scalability, security, and evaluation challenges.
